PROBABILITY_YES: 74
REASON: There has been no confirmed US land strike on Iran for 53 days. The midterm brake (votes on 3 November, Trump blocking Israel's 10 October strike plan, the WSJ report that he expects to resume bombing after the midterms) and the late-November timeline for the three-carrier build-up all favour quiet through the short window to 31 October. The resolution criteria are also narrow and exclude blockade actions, naval gunfire and disputed light-munition incidents like Konarak. Even so, Trump's "another little epic fury" remark, Barrack's "this weekend? Absolutely," the order to prepare strike options and continuing Hormuz clashes leave a real chance of a quick US "self-defence" strike before the deadline.
